node.statement: Weighted-average deduction using nodes 1.1 and 1.3: by node 1.1, L_F=sum_{f in F} w_f>0 and at least one far weight w_f is positive. For any admissible h, the weighted average over the positive far weights is A=(sum_{f in F} w_f h(p_f))/L_F. Since all weights are nonnegative and have positive total L_F, min_{f in F} h(p_f) <= A. By node 1.3, the numerator of A is <=nu_v, so A<=nu_v/L_F.
